text:
miriam: Heads up — node SDK v0.12.3 doesn't expose the rate_limit_policy param on admin.createRoute; REST API accepts it. Getting 400 'unknown field rate_limit_policy'. Repro below.

miriam: SDK call (pseudo):
```js
await client.admin.createRoute({
  name: 'ingest',
  model: 'redwood/gpt-4-realtime',
  rate_limit_policy: { qps: 20, burst: 40 }
});
```

miriam: REST that works: 
```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/routes 
  -d '{"name":"ingest","model":"redwood/gpt-4-realtime","rate_limit_policy":{"qps":20}}'
```

aj: Oof. Can you paste the exact payload the SDK is sending? We renamed rate_limit -> rate_limit_policy in the server schema last week and I thought we updated the serializers.

miriam: The SDK serializes to camelCase (rateLimitPolicy) but the generated client drops unknown extra keys and the low-level validation fails before server receives it. Error payload from SDK: 
```json
{ "error": "invalid_request","detail": "unknown field rate_limit_policy" }
```

aj: Ah — so two separate issues: 1) serializer mapping mismatch (snake_case vs camelCase in generated adapter), 2) client-side strict validation using the old schema. Thanks for repro.

devex-bot: Created issue #4621: https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/4621 (label: sdk-parity) :memo:

liam: Workaround for now if you need programmatic fix: call the raw endpoint with the SDK's rawRequest helper or curl. Example using rawRequest: 
```js
await client.rawRequest({ method: 'POST', path: '/v1/admin/routes', body: { name: 'ingest', model: 'redwood/gpt-4-realtime', rate_limit_policy: { qps: 20 } } });
```

liam: Or curl above — that hits the server directly and bypasses client-side validation.

sophie: I'll take this for the SDK sprint. @aj can you own serializer fix? We should add a small e2e (sdk <-> rest parity) for admin routes to catch this. cc: @devex-qa to add regression test.

aj: Yep — taking it. Plan: 1) align generated serializer to accept both snake_case and camelCase, 2) relax client validation for unknown fields for a short window, 3) add e2e test and roll out new SDK patch. ETA: 2 days.

miriam: Thanks — workaround works. Please ping me when a release is out :thumbsup:

sophie: Filed QA ticket and added to SDK patch release notes draft.

miriam: quick note: observed similar mismatch on webhook.register where callback_url is optional in REST but required in SDK — might be related. Will open a separate thread if we can reproduce.

aj: good catch, please open and tag sdk-parity.

miriam: will do.
